source_text: Circumcision and HIV encompasses the body of empirical research investigating the protective effect of male circumcision against HIV acquisition, primarily through randomized controlled trials demonstrating that voluntary medical male circumcision reduces the risk of heterosexually transmitted HIV in men by approximately 60% in high-prevalence sub-Saharan African settings. [1] [2]
